mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moondap.site_statistics (visit_date, visit_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_count = visit_count + 1
INSERT IGNORE INTO moondap.site_visit_log (visit_date, ip_address) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{ipAddress})
INSERT INTO moondap.site_statistics (visit_date, participation_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE participation_count = participation_count + 1
INSERT INTO moondap.site_visit_hourly (visit_date, visit_hour, view_count) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{visitHour}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, COALESCE(visit_count, 0) AS visitCount, COALESCE(participation_count, 0) AS participationCount FROM moondap.site_statistics WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY visit_date ASC
SELECT visit_hour AS visitHour, SUM(view_count) AS viewCount FROM moondap.site_visit_hourly WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY visit_hour ORDER BY visit_hour ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moondap.site_visit_log WHERE visit_date < #{cutoffDate}
